messages:
emma_sales: Hi team — kicking off a POC with BigShield Insurance. They require 1) EU-only data residency (EU + Canada acceptable), 2) no data sent to third‑party subprocessors outside EU/CA, and 3) clear failover/egress behavior for business continuity. Can presales/eng confirm what routing options we can offer and any pricing delta for a pinned regional path?

devon_presales: Thanks Emma. Quick answers: we can offer a tenant pin to eu-west-1 on Dedicated or Private. Hosted API can be biased with regional endpoints but not strictly pinned. Pricing delta: Dedicated reserved pool + regional pin has uplift — I'll pull numbers.

raj_engineer: For Dedicated/Private we can ensure compute stays in EU/CA. Important callouts: a) control plane signaling may, by default, use our control-plane endpoints which can be region-limited on Private; b) some infra metadata (healthchecks, autoscale telemetry) flows to our telemetry subprocessor — we can exclude telemetry export for strict PII rules.

olivia_sre: Ops note: our standard failover policy will attempt same-region fallback first, then adjacent region (e.g., eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1). If both saturated, cross-region failover to us-east may occur unless we apply a strict routing policy. That strict policy is available but increases latency on overload and may reduce resilience.

maria_security: From security/legal side: BigShield asked for the current subprocessor inventory + SOC2 link + KMS handling. We have a sanitized subprocessor list for EU-only POCs and a specific BYOK flow for Private deployments. I'll attach the SQ answers once we confirm control-plane routing.

emma_sales: Can someone paste the config snippet we’d give the customer to request strict regional pin and BYOK? Need to include in the SOW.

raj_engineer: Sure — sample config below (informal):
```
routing_policy:
  mode: pin
  region: eu-west-1
  failover: none  # removes cross-region fallback, increases risk
encryption:
  kms: BYOK
  key_provider: customer-kms (supported on Private/Dedicated)
```
Note: hosted API can't do BYOK today.

devon_presales: To add pricing context: Dedicated reserved pool with regional pin = base commit + ~18% regional premium for guaranteed placement. BYOK on Private has a one-time integration fee (HSM/KMS ops) if we do on-prem key escrow. I'll confirm exact numbers with finance.

emma_sales: BigShield also asked about subprocessors — can we provide a signed attestation that no data goes to non-EU subprocessors for the pinned config?

maria_security: We can provide a subprocessor attestation for Dedicated/Private that lists only EU/CA subprocessors. For Hosted it's trickier. I'll raise an internal ticket for attestation generation.

ops_bot: Ticket created: #POC-8421 — subprocessor attestation request for BigShield (eu pin). ETA 2 business days.

olivia_sre: One more ops caveat: If customer wants IP-cidr peering for data plane (VPC peering), there are network setup lead times (2-3 weeks) and cert rotation steps. Recommend we include that in POC timeline.

devon_presales: Timeline + costs noted. Emma — shall I draft SOW and add optional strict-route addendum and estimated uplift?

emma_sales: Please do. I'll attach the SQ and customer notes once Maria provides attestation. Thanks all :thumbsup:
